增量输出块列表，JSON 数组字符串。每个元素含 type（text/th: List of incremental output chunks, a JSON array string. Each element contains type (text/thinking/tool_call/tool_result/complex_table/done/error/wait_user), content (content text; when type=complex_table this is a JSON string from which table query parameters such as scene, subScene, id, stage can be parsed), and timestamp (millisecond timestamp). Pass fromIndex=0 on the first poll, and pass the nextIndex returned last time on subsequent polls to fetch incrementally.
